description: A unit hanging under an air transport: an ARMATLAS and a commander on open ground beside the ARM aircraft plant. Order the Atlas to pick the commander up (`tacli order <i> --unit <atlas> --expect ARMATLAS load unit <com> --expect-target ARMCOM`, indices from `tacli roster`). In the engine the Atlas covers the commander it carries; the cargo sorts against its transport by the merge's height offset, not as a unit level with it.
